candidates.reason: The photo background, the quote 'Dogs never bite me — just humans' and the Marilyn Monroe credit are all gone. All that's left is a lone teal rectangle, a cropped bone outline at top left, a jammed strip of tiny icons at right and a garbled white text fragment that can't be read, all on dead white space.

There is no quote, no attribution and no photo, so the message is lost entirely. Oversized dog icons are scattered across a white banner with no grid, a teal block floats right of centre, and a stray photo sliver and a dotted line go nowhere.

Nearly the same as candidate 1: the photo and quote are lost and the teal block is an empty rectangle. The icon cluster is crammed into the top right, the white text is an illegible garbled smear, and huge empty white areas leave no hierarchy at all.

This is a uniformly shrunk copy of the portrait original sitting in the middle of a wide banner. It keeps the photo, colours and quote frame, but the quote and Monroe credit are microscopic and unreadable, and about 85% of the canvas is empty white side gutters. It was not rearranged for the format.
